verdict.rationale: Datadog's APM/tracing docs (datadog-docs-23) and Log Management (datadog-docs-13) support trace-to-log correlation, and a community comment explicitly calls out tagging-based correlation across APM, metrics, and logs as a core competitive advantage (datadog-comm-3). However another hands-on community comment directly contradicts this, saying Datadog's data correlation is 'awful compared to competitors like Honeycomb, Dynatrace and Instana' and that users end up manually sifting dashboards instead of seeing correlated anomalies (datadog-comm-4). Missing for 10: first-party documentation specifically describing the trace-span-to-log/metric pivot UI workflow, and independent hands-on confirmation resolving the conflicting community reports.
